error.title: Something went wrong
error.body: We could not finish that step. Try again, or return home. Money changes are never silent when they fail.

offline.title: You are offline
offline.body: Money and Plan changes need a connection. Reading can continue when available — offline writes stay blocked.
offline.stillOffline: Still offline — connect to change Money or Plan.

permission.title: Permission needed
permission.body: Partners share daily Money, Plan, and Inbox. Some Together settings need an Admin — changes stay partner-visible.
permission.adminBody: This action needs the household Admin role. Ask your partner Admin, or open Together to review roles.

maintenance.title: Under maintenance
maintenance.body: ViNha is briefly unavailable while we care for the household ledger. Please check back soon — no offline writes will be queued.
